title: ChalMolDB Database v1.2 · Scientific Core v0.11.0 — Chalcogen Molecular Database
description:
ChalMolDB (Chalcogen Molecular Database) is a provenance-aware database and web platform for the electronic properties of chalcogen-based (S, Se, Te) donor–acceptor type semiconducting polymers and related conjugated systems. Database v1.2 contains 5,029 curated records in four collections: 3,088 development (donor–acceptor molecules), 400 external (chalcogen oligomer series), 1,323 polymer (conjugated polymers with experimental optical gaps and oligomer DFT values) and 218 literature records (S/Se/Te helicene series with CCSD(T) reference gaps and Se/Te bicyclic monomers). Every value keeps its source and level of theory. Web platform: https://chalmoldb.streamlit.app

Code: MIT License. Curated data: CC BY 4.0; third-party source data keep their original licences (listed in data/sources/).
